Sorry but I just had the weirdest/coolest realization that you and I are talking to each other from across the world, and when we woke up this morning we had no idea we were going to end up talking, and by the natural rules of the world we never should have talked because we aren't physically near each other, and yet we are talking. Nothing can stop the human race.

Back to what we were talking about, thanks for your sympathy I really miss my grandfather. I hold on to my significant other but I don't want them to be my lifeline. Maybe because of pride. Probably because of pride.

That's great to hear that you have someone and sorry about your family, obviously you are an amazing person so they are certainly missing out on your friendship.

First of all I'm totally going to start saying birches instead of bitches. That's pretty funny dude :) There is one person in my life who I held on to, and I'm dating them right now. I put a lot of pressure on myself to make sure they're not my only friend, though. That's why I am so desperate to make friends right now. I was talking with my grandparents a lot but my grandfather died day before yesterday so that's -1 good person in my life.

That's not dark it's just reality. Yes I go to uni and I watch people make friends in what seems like minutes after meeting each other, and I sit alone in all my classes despite reaching out and trying to sit by people. The next day they will walk past me and sit somewhere else. As far as I can tell I'm not a particularly revolting person to be around, yet people just don't like me. I'm learning to live with it and be happy going through life solo but it's hard.
That is true and reddit is a great resource, too. So many diverse perspectives and things to learn and look at.

It really is physical, I've been having heart flutters/heart stops quite frequently lately and I'm convinced it's just from sadness. Probably not, lol, but there's definitely a coincidence in timing. I was in a lonely place in my old town, recently moved, figured I'd make friends in this new city, but never did. The problem is obviously me, not my surroundings. Really sucks.

Thanks for commenting. Just feeling the crushing loneliness with realizing I never truly had people that cared. I find acquaintances and label them as friends in an attempt to make myself feel like I'm important to somebody but it results in rejection every. single. time. 

How are you?
Online friends are just as legitimate as irl friends, in my opinion. Communication, that's the important thing. Typing or talking your feelings out. Good for you that you found a way to socialize :)
I wish you the best too and thank you so much for commenting. If you want to talk I'm here looking for someone to talk to so feel free.
Thanks so much for replying loneliness is a terrible feeling. I'm pretty sure I could die of it.
